description_en: Queries the content of a log file for a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
description_zh: 显示一个HPO实验指定log的内容
kebab_example: aliyun paiautoml list-hpo-experiment-logs --experiment-id abcde --log-name nnimanager.log --page-number 1 --page-size 40 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHpoExperimentLogs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
parameters.name: experiment_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log. Valid values: nnimanager.log and dispatcher.log
parameters.name: log_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Page start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的日志行数。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
parameters.name: page_size

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Logs.description_en: The content of the log entry

items.description_en: The content of the log entry
items.example: [2024-03-07 18:29:29] INFO (LocalTrainingService) Run local machine training service.

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is returned if an exception occurred
Message.description_zh: 响应错误信息。只在响应出错时被设置

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the HPO experiment
v1_parameters.name: ExperimentId

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the log. Valid values: nnimanager.log and dispatcher.log
v1_parameters.name: LogName

v1_parameters.help_en: The page number. Page start from page 1. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 页码。起始值：1。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
v1_parameters.name: PageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If you leave this parameter empty, all content in the log file is returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的日志行数。不填则返回log文件里所有内容
v1_parameters.name: PageSize
